spans.s:
मठ, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably connected with
the preceding rt.), a hut, cottage, especially the re-
tired hut of an ascetic, a building inhabited by a
devotee and his disciples, a small retired room occu-
pied by a pupil, a pupil's cell; a cloister, convent,
monastery, a school, college (especially for young
Brāhmans prosecuting sacred studies); a temple; a
carriage or cart drawn by oxen; (ई), f. a cell; a
cloister.
—मठ-केशव-धारिणी, f. epithet of
Nandā the founder of the college of Keśava (Rāja-
tar.

).
—मठ-स्थिति, इस्, इस्, इ, staying or
residing in a college of priests.
—मठाधिद्पति
(˚ठ-अध्˚), इस्, or मठाध्यक्ष (˚ठ-अध्˚),
अस्, m. the superintendent of a monastery, principal
of a college, &c.
—मठायतन (˚ठ-अय्˚), अम्,
n. a monastery, convent, college.

माठ माठ or माठ्य, अस्, m. a road; [cf.
माथ, माच.]
मठिका, f. a hut, cottage; a cell.

मठर मठर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
मन्, and included in the Gaṇa Kaḍārādi, see Pāṇ.

माठर माठर, अस्, m. (fr. मठर), a
[]
patronymic, a proper N.; = Vyāsa; N. of one of
the sun's attendants; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people;
(ई), f., N. of a woman.

मठोशीलोठिका मठोशीलोठिका, f. (pro-
bably) N. of a woman.
माठरक, see Gaṇa Dhūmādi to Pāṇ.

माठरायण, अस्, m. a patronymic (Gaṇa Hari-
tādi to Pāṇ.

माठर्य, अस्, m. (fr. मठर), a patronymic,
see Schol. on Uṇādi-sūtras
माठव्य माठव्य, अस्, m. a proper N.
